mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id as menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_code, m.menu_type, m.route_name, m.route_path, m.component, m.redirect, m.query_param, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type_flag, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.order_num, m.is_system, m.remark, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.is_deleted, m.delete_time FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.order_num ASC

SELECT m.id as menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_code, m.menu_type, m.route_name, m.route_path, m.component, m.redirect, m.query_param, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type_flag, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.order_num, m.is_system, m.remark, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.is_deleted, m.delete_time FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND rm.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.order_num ASC

SELECT m.id as menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_code, m.menu_type, m.route_name, m.route_path, m.component, m.redirect, m.query_param, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type_flag, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.order_num, m.is_system, m.remark, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.is_deleted, m.delete_time FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.parent_id = #{parentId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.order_num ASC

SELECT m.id as menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_code, m.menu_type, m.route_name, m.route_path, m.component, m.redirect, m.query_param, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type_flag, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.order_num, m.is_system, m.remark, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.is_deleted, m.delete_time FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.order_num ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
